chunks: By Him who deputed him as a Prophet with truth,

the tree did remove itself with its root and came with a great humming sound and a flapping like the flapping of the wings of birds, till it stopped before the Messenger of Allāh and cast its higher branches over the Prophet, while some of its branches came down onto my shoulders, and I was on the right side of the Holy Prophet.
ai.seo_question: What is the story of the tree that moved to the Prophet Muhammad in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This vivid narrative from Nahj al-Balagha illustrates the concept of 'Tasbih al-Khalq' (the glorification of creation), where nature actively responds to the Prophet's presence, a theme deeply rooted in Shia exegesis. The tree's movement and placement of its branch symbolize the submission of the material world to divine authority, reinforcing the Prophet's status as the focal point of cosmic order. This event serves as a metaphor for the believer's heart, which should similarly be responsive and humble before the Messenger of God.

the tree did remove itself with its root and came with a great humming sound and a flapping like the flapping of the wings of birds, till it stopped before the Messenger of Allāh and cast its higher branches over the Prophet, while some of its branches came down onto my shoulders, and I was on the right side of the Holy Prophet.
